Keele University GREAT Scholarships 2025-26 is a combined initiative of Keele University and the British Council for students willing to pursue Master's in Business and Computing at Keele University in the 2025-26 academic year. This sceme aims to help the support students to access world-class higher education opportunities. The selected scholar will receive £10,000 (approximately ₹10,50,000) for tuition fees.
To be eligible, an applicant must -
be a resident of India, Pakistan, and Bangladesh
be enrolled in one-year master’s programme in Business and Computing at Keele University
This scheme is not available for students studying fully online courses delivered by Keele.
The selected scholar will receive £10,000 (approximately ₹10,50,000) for tuition fees.
